name: Urz Buccaneers
original_name: ウルズ＝バッカーニアーズ
source:
Despite her cute appearance, she is a headstrong and victorious princess. She leads her ships and pirates to raid coastal cities one after another, and spends her days looting and plundering.  

Like her father, she dreams of one day being called a pirate king, a name that will be feared throughout the land. 

She acts and behaves like a boy, and her language is coarse. She thinks she is dignified, but because she looks childish, people think she is cute, and she is often underestimated.  In such cases, she uses force to silence them.

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill03/chara.html]official site[/url]]
